messages:
sam: Heads-up: all-hands tomorrow 10:30am PT in main room. Short agenda and asks below — drop up to two questions in-thread or use the form.

sam: Agenda (rough timings)
- 10:30-10:35 company update (hiring + product milestones)
- 10:35-10:45 Launch callout: Redis KV cache pilot + rollout plan (eng + infra)
- 10:45-10:55 Policy update: API key rotation & scoped keys (security + legal)
- 10:55-11:00 Incident recap: hosted-api latency spike (SRE)
- 11:00-11:10 Live Q&A (we'll prioritize pre-submitted)

jana: Launch callout brief: Redis KV cache pilot will start with internal apps then select customers. Expected benefits: lower token recompute, faster prefix hits, and small cost savings. We'll open Pilot Labs in the Console with live hit-rate metrics.

owen: Ops plan snippet:
``
- Day -10: infra provisioning across us-west and eu-central
- Day -4: internal perf runs + canary traffic
- Day 0: enable pilot flag for internal apps
- Day +7: invite 3 external customers for test cohort
```

owen: Note: we plan to keep TTL defaults conservative during pilot to avoid stale results.

rachel: Policy change summary: we're tightening API key rotation cadence and introducing scoped keys (read-only embeddings, generation-only, admin). This will help reduce blast radius and helps compliance with data residency. Pilot customers will see feature flag first.

rachel: Compliance ask: any teams with long-lived automation tokens please flag now so security can add migration docs. Form: https://forms.gle/rdw-allhands-pol-asks

sam: Incident recap preview: yesterday's hosted-api latency spike traced to a misrouted traffic burst + ephemeral cache thundering. Mitigations: rate-limiter tweak, pre-warming cache shards, and a new synthetic check for tail latency across regions.

infra-bot: :calendar: Invite created and recording placeholder attached to event. Post-meeting notes + one-pager will be uploaded to the #all-hands channel.

sam: If you have a demo or slides, send to me by EOD. Keep demos to max 3 slides. Execs prefer concise pre-submitted Qs (1-2).

jana: Extra ask for product: if you want us to show specific Console graphs during the call, paste the route names here (e.g., /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings).

sam: Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow. Recording + short playbook after for any action items. :sparkles:
